answers.core: JSON Resource is a native type, and it is a great way of wrapping miscellaneous data in a resource for storage. Using it in extensions and addons allow having only a single wrapper type instead of creating wrapper scripts exporting arrays just for the sake of storing untyped data. I personally think having it on core would be of great value for those that create addons.
answers.workaround: I suppose it is possible. I have already seen addons that change the inspector, so I assume it is perfectly possible to create an addon for that.

title: Allow inspecting the "data" property of the JSON resource in the inspector
